modern_kimi_batch_reset_r9122.effect: Reset all GPU KV/Conv/KDA and PairState to phase0; preserve model weights; capture1 state-only/capture0 oldspec or pairAR; all cohort slots initially empty; epoch counter remains monotonic.

modern_kimi_batch_mode_r9122.effect: Clear only speculative feature-state cache, preserve per-request PairState/past/rows, used only after ready/terminal transactions.

modern_kimi_batch_prefill_r9122.effect: Each selected unprefilled logical row gets input width=offset[i+1]-offset[i], positions0..width-1, past becomes width/phase1. Multiple subset prefill calls allowed before decode; no duplicate/reused/EOS slot admission.

modern_kimi_batch_forward_r9122.effect: Packed true native batch. All selected rows phase1; verify input anchor+K proposals per request, 1<=width<=8, sumwidth<=16; total_i=past_i+width_i, position_i=past_i+arange(width_i). On success each phase2; one immutable capture epoch covers selected vector if mode1.

modern_kimi_batch_commit_r9122.effect: Exactly same selected row order/count as last forward. Atomic preflight+commit. accepted0..width-1, retained=accepted+1. continuation0 marks phase4 (EOS/cap), fullaccept continuation1 swaps pair/advancespast/phase1, partial continuation1 sets phase3 until replay.

modern_kimi_batch_replay_r9122.effect: Requires at least one phase3. state_only must match reset/mode capture. Partial subset order inherited last verify; original active state/past used; fullaccept and phase4 skipped. state1 fused owner state update then actual CPU shadow length crop then PairState swap, outflags0/no head output. state0 one packed fullModel prefix replay on phase3 subset then PairState completion, actual output shape sum partialretained; caller may capture new batch taps for that exact subset.
modern_kimi_batch_replay_r9122.n_out: sum(retained_i for phase3 rows) only for state0

modern_kimi_batch_taps_begin_r9122.effect: Only batch feature memory export. Explicit immutable selected metadata. enabled0 accepts count0 and NULL arrays. ON total<=8192, count1..8, width1..1024. Does not arm old B1 live tap API.

modern_kimi_batch_taps_count_r9122.effect: Number of layer records on this node representative. TP16PP2 node0 layers19,37; node2 layers66,78,90; node1/3 zero.
